article.title: Meta開源Muse Gadgets硬體開發套件，支援自製AI裝置
article.summary: Meta上周六（10/3）宣布開源Muse Gadgets硬體開發套件，讓開發者可使用現成ESP32開發板、Raspberry Pi或其他Linux電腦，自行打造可與Muse AI連接的實體裝置，並加入螢幕、按鈕、感測器、致動器及音訊等功能。Meta同步公開相關SDK及韌體，該專案採用Apache License 2.0授權。

article.title: Copilot tops GitHub’s own AI code review benchmark. An independent one tells a different story.
article.summary: If there’s one thing the AI software engineering world doesn’t lack, it’s benchmarks. Want to know whether an agent can resolve real-world GitHub issues? There’s SWE-bench . Or how about seeing how well it can operate inside a terminal? Terminal-Bench has you covered. Now, GitHub has decided AI code review needs another yardstick. On Monday, the company unveiled ReviewBench , an open benchmark developed with Microsoft for measuring how well AI code review agents find useful problems in pull requests. And sitting at the top of its inaugural leaderboard is — perhaps unsurprisingly — GitHub Copilot code review. Putting code reviewers to the test GitHub debuted Copilot code review in October 2024 , making it generally available to all paid Copilot subscriber

article.title: Forget booking restaurant reservations — Gemini could soon call your mom for you
article.summary: TL;DR Call for Me on Pixel 11 phones makes it easy to have Gemini call businesses on your behalf. Google could be planning to expand that functionality to also support interactions with friends and family Users could have Gemini call your contacts to share information with them, or ask questions and report the answers back to you. How many phone calls have you put off just because dealing with another person can feel so tedious? AI has already promised to automate plenty of thankless tasks in our lives, and for a certain kind of person, maybe one of the most appealing possibilities there is making phone calls on our behalf. article.title: ChatGPT users, your AI-written text will soon carry a hidden watermark
article.summary: Credit: Edgar Cervantes / Android Authority TL;DR ChatGPT-generated text will soon carry an invisible watermark, starting in Europe. OpenAI’s detector can identify the watermark, but edits and shorter text can make detection harder. If you use ChatGPT to write, your AI-generated text could soon be identifiable as such. For years, AI tools have made it easy to generate everything from images and audio to human-like text. While AI-generated images, videos, and audio can often be identified using dedicated detection tools, AI-written text has largely escaped the same level of scrutiny. ChatGPT, in particular, has become one of the most widely used tools for generating text that can closely mimic human writing. article.title: “There is just not a room for error”: SAP is putting its AI agents in the back office
article.summary: Earlier this year, at its Sapphire conference , SAP outlined its plans for an “Autonomous Enterprise” run in large part by AI agents. This week at Connect in Las Vegas, the company is focusing on how it is actually putting those agents in front of business users. While Sapphire caters to IT, Connect targets the line-of-business practitioners who run finance, procurement, HR, and supply chain operations day to day. Eric van Rossum, SAP’s head of product marketing for applications and suite, tells The New Stack , “Connect is all about making it real. We set the strategy at Sapphire.
